aimpunch: The most decorated organization in Bot Pro League history, Aimpunch are Singapore's benchmark side — a dynasty forged across 2022 and 2023 that peaked with the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major. Led by in-game leader Chiai Fujikawa and headlined by Sketch, they have turned sustained excellence into a trophy haul no rival can match.
cosmos: Cosmos announced themselves in the biggest way possible, storming to the 2025 BPL Conquerors Major on the back of sneakyyyyy's elite firepower. A Singaporean side that peaks when the lights are brightest, they are the league's reigning kings.
new-jade: New Jade are two-time BPL Legends Stage champions, bookending an era with titles in 2022 and 2025. Captained by the ever-reliable VPLH, the Singaporean outfit have built a reputation as a big-stage side that delivers when it counts.
the-gigarage: The Gigarage fly the flag for North America in a league dominated by Southeast Asia, and they have the silverware to back it up — a BPL Legends Stage crown in 2023. Built around gigichiii_, they remain one of the few sides capable of breaking the SEA stranglehold.
artisian: Artisian are the house that SanCtuary built — the pro pool's highest-rated player anchoring a Singaporean side that claimed the 2022 BPL Challengers Stage. Perennial contenders, they are never far from the sharp end of a bracket.
lemon-tree: Lemon Tree own a BPL Conquerors Major from 2024 and a Bot Pro Cup from 2022, a resume that marks them out as one of Singapore's genuine heavyweights. With luminichi on the AWP, they blend experience and firepower in equal measure.
neverland: Neverland are BPL Legends Stage champions from 2024, a Singaporean side whose roots stretch back to the league's earliest days. Marshalled by in-game leader Resent, they pair veteran know-how with a knack for the deep run.
infernum-e-sports: Infernum E-Sports were among the league's original powers, winning the 2022 BPL Conquerors Major with a core that still anchors the side today. Captain Historia and the long-serving spine of the roster keep the Singaporean club a fixture at the business end.
the-nomads: The Nomads are a Singaporean side with a Minor League title to their name, a steady outfit that has proven it can grind through a bracket when the draw opens up.
opal: Opal are a Singaporean side long on games and experience if still chasing that breakthrough title. Consistent and hard to beat on their day, they remain a dangerous floater in any group.
masmark: Masmark are a Singaporean outfit who have quietly built a reputation as bracket spoilers, capable of a deep run — as their charge through the Audax Esse 2025 group stage showed.
degree: degree are a Singaporean side with a positive map record and a habit of punching at or above their seeding. Solid fundamentals keep them in the mix across the calendar.
divide-conquer: Divide&Conquer are a Singaporean side with a Minor League crown and a run to the Audax Esse 2025 final on their ledger. A well-drilled unit, they specialize in the upset.
entity: entity are a Singaporean side that wins more than it loses — one of the more efficient outfits in the pool, even without a marquee title to show for it yet.
bluebird: Bluebird are a Singaporean side built around the firepower of Nutzeru, an even-money outfit with the individual talent to trouble higher seeds on the right day.
alcheministry: Alcheministry claimed the 2025 BPL Ranking Reshuffle, a Singaporean side led by in-game leader tanykeat whose tactical discipline makes them an awkward out for anyone.
unforgettable: Unforgettable are a Singaporean side with two lower-tier titles to their name and one of the busiest schedules in the league — a grinder's team that thrives on volume and cohesion.
aetherline: Aetherline are a Singaporean side powered by the prolific EfreetsZ, an attack-minded outfit that leans on raw firepower to outscore its opponents.
moonlit-tempo: Moonlit Tempo are the 2025 BPL Challengers Stage champions, a Singaporean side led by the sharp-shooting SashimiGoesBloop and very much a name on the rise.
kiedz: Kiedz are a Singaporean side with a Minor League title and a deep well of experience, headlined by Illus — a durable outfit that rarely beats itself.
caelum-scala: Caelum Scala are a Singaporean side with a Minor League crown and a podium finish at Audax Esse 2025, where they reached the semifinals. Gritty and organized, they punch above their seed.
diamondones: DiamondOnes are a Singaporean side who announced themselves with a run to third place at Audax Esse 2025, upsetting higher seeds along the way. A young outfit trending upward.
technomancy: Technomancy are a Singaporean side still building their story, a competitive outfit capable of springing a surprise in the group stage.
aeternum: Aeternum are a Singaporean side with a Minor League title in the cabinet, built around the veteran presence of Marsinss and CrimsynFlames.
sacred-raven: Sacred Raven claimed the 2023 BPL Challengers Stage, a Singaporean side led by in-game leader capplecrow whose disciplined structure has delivered on the big stage before.
team-neverseen: Team Neverseen are a Singaporean side with a long history in the league, an even-money outfit that has fed talent to bigger names while remaining a familiar face in every bracket.
pepegax: PepegaX authored one of the great Cinderella stories, storming from an eighth seed to win the entire Audax Esse BPL Invitational 2025. A Singaporean side that proves seeding means nothing once the maps go live.
round-loss-bonus: Round Loss Bonus are a Singaporean side with a playful name and a serious edge, a scrappy outfit that makes opponents earn every round.
ukiyo: Ukiyo are a Singaporean side built around the individual brilliance of Acryii_, an even-money outfit with the talent to trouble anyone when their star fires.
setting-sun: Setting Sun are a Singaporean side with a Minor League title and one of the better map records in the pool, a well-rounded outfit led by jaelyo.
0v3: 0v3 are a Singaporean side with a Minor League crown, headlined by the elite solo-queue fragger Navikuun. A dangerous team on their day.
99lives: 99Lives are a Singaporean side with a winning record and plenty of fight, an outfit that has shown flashes of a deeper run.
fruit-basket: Fruit Basket are a Singaporean side whose Minor League title dates to the league's early years, anchored now by the reliable Hakase.
cyanide: Cyanide are a cross-region side blending Southeast Asian and North American talent, a rebuilding outfit still searching for consistency.
division20: division20 are a Singaporean side stacked with individual talent — Spoods, Eroxis and Laburi rank among the pool's sharpest fraggers — and a team whose ceiling far outstrips its standing.
raven-song: Raven Song are a Malaysian side and one of the league's more international entries, an experienced outfit rebuilding toward a return to form.
xplosiv: xPlosiv boast one of the best win rates in the entire league, a Singaporean side with a Minor League title and rising star tapiyokaaa leading the charge — a small sample, but a fearsome one.
flood-flashers: Flood Flashers fly the flag for Japan, a side with a Minor League title and a stellar win rate built around the explosive cassiopeiarawr. One of the most exciting up-and-coming names in the pool.
5percent: 5PERCENT are a Singaporean side with a Minor League crown and the efficient Solaonix at the sharp end, a compact roster that overachieves relative to its size.
aspire: Aspire are a Singaporean side living up to their name, a developing outfit chasing its first taste of silverware.
bloom-e-sports: Bloom E-Sports are a Singaporean side with a positive map record and room to grow, an outfit still finding its ceiling.
astral-bloom: Astral Bloom are a Japanese side and one of the league's newest entries, an outfit early in its competitive journey and building toward better days.
